meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.Internal.s: The statement is about Lean’s totalized second Fréchet derivative under C¹ regularity; it does not assert classical C² regularity.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsKeyField: The second derivative is the totalized Fréchet derivative of the first derivative.
The smoothness predicate in this file requires C¹ regularity with Lipschitz gradients on closed balls.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.Frac: The denominator is a natural number and may be zero until a later validity predicate imposes positivity.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.FracEq: The raw cross-product relation is not transitive on all stored pairs: (1, 1) relates to (0, 0), which relates to (2, 1), while the first and last do not relate. Positive-denominator guards restore the intended interpretation as equality of rational quotients.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.SquareIntern: This is an energy inequality, with nonnegative unit-mass smoothing and local integrability assumptions.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.headPotential: The pressure normalization subtracts the unit-ball average, fixing the additive constant.
